description: A wooden amusement pier extending from a broad sandy beach into the blue ocean. A large colorful Ferris wheel rises above the pier near a compact roller coaster with bright yellow track and blue supports. Include simple low buildings, railings, timber support piles, foamy waves, and a few palm trees near the shore. There are no written signs.
